ideas.pitch: Real-time Calgary Transit crowd-sourcing and predictive bus bunching mitigation app using local GTFS feeds.

ideas.pitch: Peer-to-peer neighborhood tool library inventory tracker and trust scoring system designed for community associations in Calgary.
